decisions.reason: The source changes only the referral-specific Mint Successful modal text; it does not request any change to FAQ content.
The modal wording does not change landing-page hero copy or layout.
The source concerns an in-product mint-success modal and does not change transactional email delivery or content.
The modal describes the existing referral ticket outcome but does not alter ticket issuance, weighting, expiration, or reset rules.
The source explicitly applies when a referral code is used and therefore does not change no-referral or invalid-referral allocation.
Mentioning the existing $5 commission in modal copy does not change primary-mint revenue amounts or destinations.
The client changes only modal feedback and does not request corresponding About-page copy changes.
The source does not change fiat wallet provisioning, dashboard access, reward access, or cash-out guidance.
Referring to the chosen NFT holder in success copy does not change NFT resale or state-transfer semantics.
The modal's mention of a $500 prize-draw ticket does not change prize-pool values or draw-progress displays.
The source has no effect on landing-page book-cover location, size, overlap, or visibility.
The source reports referral commission and ticket allocation, not prize-winner payout or collection behavior.
